transcript: The following notice gives details for a planned activity. A student group at the community hall tested three ways to protect young plants. Covers blocked wind but also reduced light. A low wall stopped some wind without shading the leaves. Moving the plants indoors kept them warm but required more space. The group chose the low wall for the next two weeks.
